body.statement: For every observed law \(P\) compatible with \(\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\), \(\theta\) is point identified over all compatible full-data laws if and only if \(\ker(A_P)\subseteq\ker(R_0)\), equivalently \(\nu(P)=0\), equivalently there exists \(F_P\) with \(F_PA_P=R_0\). In that event \(\theta=F_Pb_P\). This strictly strengthens the bridge-fiber criterion in Proposition 2.3 of \cite{ZhangLiMiaoTchetgen2023} on the finite tangent-rich causal model because the necessity direction is witnessed by full causal completions, while its purely statistical criterion is recovered by forgetting those completions.
body.justification: The equivalence is the paper's exact identification frontier and yields an observable formula whenever identification holds.
body.gap: The closest published result is Zhang et al.'s annihilator condition for a linear functional of a statistical bridge solution; causal realizability of every violating direction and simultaneous preservation across randomized edges are absent.
body.consumer: NETMOTION investigators can determine which oxygen-level risk differences are point identified without requiring recovery of the full bridge.
